description: Bounded source-record curation metadata for a future reconstruction tree. Original source bytes are not bundled.

authority_policy.join_rule: Managed records and TS or native build records are distinct authorities. No cross-build join is allowed.

non_managed_identity_policy.binary_authority: Do not promote a historical client hash to direct JS or native source authority without an accepted byte lineage.

architecture_identity.namespace_policy: Retain observed namespace or global placement as context; do not infer it from a filename.
architecture_identity.type_method_identity: Use TypeDef and MethodDef under the full managed authority identity.

schema_contract.orthogonality: evidence_status, source_status, verification_basis, curation_status, export_status, completeness, and representation are separate fields; readability or decompile output cannot upgrade evidence status
schema_contract.path_rule: All paths are local relative research or prospective paths; no parent Markdown link is a manifest reference
